browser.scope: RAF closure requested after the observation window and resolved by this observer only after recording a RAF timestamp at or after that request. Already-queued stale RAF timestamps do not close the window. Wall time, RAF-covered span and boundary gaps are separate. LongTasks are browser main-thread tasks, not GPU time.

rate_formulas.observed_window_fps: RAF callbacks observed / full actual wall capture duration; callback throughput, not proof of GPU presentation
rate_formulas.completed_interval_fps: complete consecutive RAF intervals / their covered RAF timestamp span; must be read with coverage and uncovered boundary gaps
